sections.A: Girna woh achanak waqia hai jis mein insaan zameen ya neechi jagah par aa jata hai. Frailty mein jism ki taaqat aur reserve kam ho jata hai aur girne ka risk barh jata hai.
sections.B: Har bari umar ke shakhs se poochein: pichle saal gire? kitni baar? kya chalte waqt ladkhadahat ya girne ka darr hai?
sections.D: TUG, 30-second chair stand, balance tests aur girne ke darr ka scale (FES-I).
sections.G: Girne ke saath behoshi, dhadkan tez ya seene ka dard (dil), ya khoon patla karne ki dawa par sar ki chot: urgent medical.
sections.H: Screen karein: pichle saal girna, ladkhadahat, darr. Positive ho to multifactorial assessment aur intervention.
sections.I: Balance ko challenge karne wali exercise, baqaida aur kaafi arsay tak, girna kam karti hai. Saath mein taaqat ki exercise.
sections.M: TUG, chair stand, balance tests, FES-I aur girne ki diary dobara dekhein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Balance ko challenge karne wali exercise taaqat ke saath girna kam karti hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
